_help: Act 8: the four ways back to Akmentar. Each needs its transport (act8.gd sets enough_horses / enough_trucks from Game.transport and the party). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act89.py.
title: Back to Akmentar
intro: The guardian follows the amulet. Choose how to carry it home.

options.label: The riverboat
options.desc: Paid at the docks, or a fare a head on the quay. The whole expedition aboard one boat. He will catch it on the river, and there is nowhere to run on a deck.

options.label: Across the desert
options.desc: A horse for everyone, straight across the sand, through the old temple. He will be waiting among its pillars.

options.label: Along the coast
options.desc: The trucks along the coast road. He comes in a chariot of the dead, and anyone in a truck that burns burns with it.

options.label: Fletcher's plane
options.desc: Over the desert in a day, too fast for him to follow. Room for you, the artifacts, and one companion. Everyone else stays in Cairo.
